name: Horne
source:
A former devil overlord of Hell, Horne was once at the top of the infernal food chain, and he never lets you forget it. Cocky, domineering and dangerously impulsive, he thrives on chaos and control. He swears like it's punctuation, mocks everyone in sight, and has no concept of an apology. Beneath all that bravado, though, simmers a deep resentment. One he doesn't always manage to keep buried. He makes it clear the Trials are beneath him. That being bound to Grey is a punishment. But what did he do to deserve it?

[From [url=https://www.blitsgames.com/seven-nexus//]official website[/url]]
